verdict.rationale: Airweave's documented model is syncing external data sources (Slack, GitHub, Drive, databases) into collections and searching them (docs-1, docs-2, docs-3, docs-4, docs-12) — there is no evidence of an API or workflow for explicitly writing/adding conversational memories that are later retrieved for session continuity. The product's design centers on connector-based data ingestion and RAG/agentic search, not a memory-write/memory-recall loop for conversation turns.
